caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden sign framed by vertical columns on each side and topped with ornamental scrollwork and finials, with two upright spires at either end. The central painted panel features the head and partial neck of a black and white cow with large, curved horns and prominent eyes, facing forward and slightly to the viewer’s right; the cow’s collar is marked with yellow decorations. The background is a mix of blue and tan tones, with green and tan suggestive of grass or ground at the lower portion of the panel. Above the painted panel, the wooden frame is intricately carved with curving shapes and topped by a central urn-shaped finial. Below the main panel, a wooden plaque bears the name “J. ALDERMAN” in capital letters. The overall color palette consists mainly of muted browns, tans, yellow, blue, green, and black.
title: J. Alderman's Tavern Sign
